_comment: Edited on the server after deploy. MUST be served with no-cache - if this file is cached, changing apiBaseUrl silently does nothing. See docs/RUNBOOK.md.
_refreshMs_comment: The DEFAULT auto-refresh; the viewer can override it with the refresh picker (REFRESH_CHOICES in src/state/prefsStore.ts) and that choice persists per browser. 5000 to match the plant board next to it, and it must be one of those choices or the menu opens with nothing ticked. MUST also stay ABOVE the backend SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL_MS (default 2000ms): the UI calls the feed frozen after 3 identical payloads, so a client outrunning the poller false-alarms on a healthy system.
_windowedRequestTimeoutMs_comment: How long to wait for a board the server has to ASSEMBLE - a calendar window, or the 7d quick range. Separate from requestTimeoutMs because the two differ by an order of magnitude: the default board is one in-memory read, while a month-wide calendar pick is dozens of sequential InfluxDB queries (measured 10-14.5s on 2026-09-08 for the widest window the picker allows, and they cannot be parallelised - see server/src/services/windowedSnapshot.ts). Optional; omitting it uses 45000.
_tileUrl_comment: null ON PURPOSE - do not paste the CARTO URL back. basemaps.cartocdn.com now stamps 'API KEY REQUIRED' diagonally across every tile it serves without a key, in both light_all and dark_all and at both 1x and @2x, and it returns them as 200 OK - so RasterTileLayer's tileerror fallback never fires and the watermark just sits on the board. The bundled Natural Earth outlines in src/components/map/BaseGeoLayer.tsx are the base layer either way, and at nine pins on a world view they are the better base: no city labels, roads or terrain competing with the pins, no public internet needed (T-12). A site that wants raster back needs a keyed provider - set tileUrl, tileUrlDark and tileAttribution together, because a credit that does not match the URL is a licence breach.
_grafanaBaseUrl_comment: The Grafana instance the drill-down links open. The backend builds the path (/d/adz5fll/... - see server/src/config/grafana.ts) and the browser prefixes it with this, so the two MUST name the same instance. Change it here on the server; no rebuild.
